pages.text: $(l)Create$() builds machines from moving parts: shafts, cogs, belts and windmills carry $(l)rotational force$() around, and contraptions physically move in the world instead of processing items in a box.$(br2)Its processing happens on millstones, mixers and presses, which are not crafting recipes.

Millstones, mixers and presses are not crafting recipes, so zinc, andesite alloy, brass and rose quartz are priced by hand at $(l)Tier 2$() and $(l)Tier 3$().$(br2)Andesite alloy is the mod's early staple and is priced accordingly, so printing a stack of it is never the cheap route past building the machine that makes it.
